slides.headline: VIDEO GAMES SECRETLY BUILT 4 OF AI'S BIGGEST POWERS
slides.image_prompt: A person plays at a vintage arcade cabinet displaying $ and warning triangle symbols in fire-engine red and electric blue neon, well-lit, wide-angle shot.

slides.headline: 1) LEARN NEW SKILLS WITHOUT FORGETTING THE OLD ONES
slides.body:
TODAY'S AI FORGETS EVERY SKILL WHEN YOU TEACH IT A NEW ONE.

Google's games fix this. Their AI learns chess without forgetting how to drive. Soon your business AI can do the same

slides.headline: 2) BUILD AI MEMORY THAT STORES MONTHS, NOT MINUTES
slides.body:
TODAY'S AI FORGETS YOUR LAST CONVERSATION THE SECOND YOU CLOSE THE TAB.

Google is building memory that stores and retrieves everything, forever. That changes what your AI coworker can do

slides.headline: 15 YEARS.
slides.body: Google's AI went from Pong to beating the world's best StarCraft players. Now it is learning to plan your whole year

slides.headline: 3) MAKE AI PLAN MONTHS AHEAD, NOT JUST SECONDS
slides.body:
CHESS AI SEES 20 MOVES AHEAD. GOOGLE WANTS AI THAT PLANS OVER WEEKS, MONTHS, AND YEARS.

That is the gap between a calculator and a business partner you can actually trust

slides.headline: 4) WATCH AI AGENTS NEGOTIATE WITH EACH OTHER FOR YOU
slides.body:
GOOGLE IS BUILDING AI THAT COOPERATES, NEGOTIATES, AND CREATES ECONOMIES INSIDE VIRTUAL WORLDS.

Their partner Fable is building the living universe to test it. Your business could be next

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: 4 AI POWERS BUILT IN VIDEO GAMES
slides.body:
Learn skills, never forget old ones
Memory that stores months of context
Planning over weeks and years
Agents that negotiate for you

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 4. 🎮 Google spent 15 years training AI inside video games, and what it learned will change what AI can do for your business.

Continual learning so AI never forgets old skills, deep memory systems that store months of context, long-horizon planning over weeks and months, multi-agent dynamics where AI negotiates with AI, all built from 15 years of game research at Google DeepMind.

Video games have been Google's AI laboratory for 15 years. The 4 problems they are solving aren't just for games. They are the blueprint for every AI business tool coming in the next 3 years. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: GoogleDeepMind

#AI #artificialintelligence #technology #AIforbusiness #AIfuture
